messages:
Zoe L.: hey team — quick question for new folks: what’s the short checklist for where to post different asks? hardware, VPN, access, and bots are a bit confusing to me
Samir: hi! welcome Zoe :wave: tl;dr: tickets (IT) -> #help for quick Qs -> channel threads for team convos. but here’s a slightly expanded map
Samir: hardware / laptop imaging / replacement -> open a ticket with IT via the Helpdesk portal or DM Ben and run /it-ticket in Slack. don’t @here in #eng for hardware asks
Ben (IT): to add: use the slash command `
```
Ben (IT): /helpdesk new "Laptop issue" --priority=normal --tags=new-hires
```
Ben (IT): that creates a ticket and pings IT. if you need expedited setup say "new hire first day" in the description
Priya K.: VPN / badge / building access -> ping Ben (IT) or DM the facilities channel (see sticky in #people-ops). For VPN we usually ask for the OS + laptop serial and then send the onboarding profile
Zoe L.: cool. what about bots? there are a bunch in sidebar and i’m not sure which ones are safe to leave on or mute
Samir: onboard-bot is good — it posts onboarding tasks. Disable noise from deploy-bot if you don’t need deploys: click the bot, then the channel app settings -> "notifications". For per-channel bot policy: keep alerts in the channel that owns the service (e.g., #eng-runtime-alerts), and DMs for paged oncalls
Priya K.: etiquette notes: 1) use threads for followups on a root message (don’t litter channel). 2) prefer @person instead of @here except for true emergencies. 3) add context in one line + a follow-up if verbose. 4) tag with `#oncall` or `@oncall` if you need immediate attention
Samir: quick examples:
- hardware: DM Ben (IT) + /helpdesk (creates ticket)
- infra access: open an access request in #eng-infra with your github id + justification
- product feedback: drop in #product-feedback, use threads
Zoe L.: any channel naming conventions? helps to find the right place
Priya K.: yes — short guide:
- team channels: `#eng-*`, `#eng-runtime`, `#eng-infra`
- cross-team ops: `#platform-ops`, `#support`
- product & feedback: `#product`, `#product-feedback`
- general announcements: `#announcements` (read-only for most)
Ben (IT): one more: if you create a ticket via /helpdesk you’ll get the ticket number in the thread — paste that back here if you want help tracking. and if you need laptop image instructions there’s a pinned doc in #new-hires with the exact steps
onboard-bot: Welcome Zoe L.! Check items 1, 2, 3 in your onboarding checklist and confirm when done :tada:
Zoe L.: thank you all — this is super helpful. i'll open the ticket now and post the number here. also — saved the channel map :raised_hands:
